prose: Crusoe announced that Google acquired its southeast Wyoming data-center site, ending Crusoe's pre-development work on site selection, approvals and a hybrid power strategy with Tallgrass Energy. CEO Chase Lochmiller says the pre-construction work set up the project for construction. Crusoe says it has more than 6 GW contracted and over 40 GW in its pipeline. The announcement is dated Nov. 6, 2026.
highlights: Google buys Crusoe's southeast Wyoming site
Crusoe did site selection, approvals and hybrid power with Tallgrass
Crusoe: 6 GW contracted, 40+ GW in pipeline
